page_title: MON 4-1 CLE | Monaco v Clermont 04/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Clermont as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

90+5' There's a break in play and referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Clermont using VAR. This could be interesting!
90+4' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Krepin Diatta (Monaco). Penalty awarded! Clermont will take a penalty kick.
90+1' It's time for a substitution. Caio Henrique (Monaco) comes on in place of Maghnes Akliouche.
90+1' Adi Hutter has decided to make a change. Mamadou Coulibaly (Monaco) replaces Takumi Minamino.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Mohamed-Amine Bouchenna (Clermont).
87' 4 - 1 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) unleashes a shot straight into the bottom left corner. Good team effort!
86' The manager makes a subsitution with Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) coming on for Mohamed Camara.
81' Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
78' We are about to witness a substitution. Mohamed-Amine Bouchenna (Clermont) is replacing Alan Virginius.
77' Pascal Gastien has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Shamar Nicholson (Clermont) replacing Grejohn Kyei.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Maximiliano Caufriez departs the field of play to be replaced by Florent Ogier (Clermont).
77' The Monaco players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
77' Monaco score a goal, but referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
75' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
69' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sees a yellow card from Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
69' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
66' Breel Embolo goes off the pitch and Folarin Balogun (Monaco) comes on.
65' It is time for a substitution. Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) is on for Vanderson.
63' Pascal Gastien prepares a substitution. Mehdi Zeffane is replaced by Jeremy Jacquet (Clermont).
62' Substitution. Jeremie Bela makes way for Ilhan Fakili (Clermont).
61' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem shows the yellow card to Vanderson (Monaco) for a heavy challenge.
61' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Breel Embolo (Monaco) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
58' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Clermont.
57' 3 - 1 Goal! Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:1.
56' Jeremie Bela (Clermont) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
53' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem interrupts the game. One of the players from Clermont won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
52' Flag up against Grejohn Kyei (Clermont). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
51' The foul by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem.
48' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
45+1' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and rose high to reach a fine corner kick. He fails to direct the ball past the goalkeeper as it flies narrowly over the bar.
43' The linesman points to the corner flag, Clermont are going to take it.
42' Clermont concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Monaco have a free kick from a promising distance.
37' 2 - 1 Breel Embolo (Monaco) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike, which goes inside the left post.
34' 1 - 1 Muhammed Cham (Clermont) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets low into the middle of the goal.
33' Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) makes a rough challenge and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle for a foul.
30' Vanderson (Monaco) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
30' Clermont failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
28' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Clermont have a free kick.
27' It looks like Maximiliano Caufriez (Clermont) saw red with that tackle. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
25' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) commits a rough foul. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem stops the game and makes a call.
24' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem saw the whole situation.
23' The linesman raises his flag. Alan Virginius (Clermont) is adjudged offside.
22' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

22' Vanderson (Monaco) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem with no other option than to blow for a foul.
20' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
16' 1 - 0 Takumi Minamino (Monaco) struck from medium range, curling the ball into the top right corner. What a hit! Pure magic.
15' Muhammed Cham (Clermont) was too forceful with his tackle and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

15' Breel Embolo (Monaco) unleashes a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Mory Diaw thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
12' The referee blows his whistle as Grejohn Kyei (Clermont) was too aggressive in his challenge.
10' Neto Borges (Clermont) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
9' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows his whistle. Breel Embolo (Monaco) commits a foul after dangerous play.
5' Flag goes up against Mehdi Zeffane (Clermont) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
3' The corner is swung in but Clermont can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
3' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Clermont. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Clermont.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Clermont will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem will officiate today.
